reviews.title: Smooth like butter!
reviews.comment: I just received my shiny new mechanical keyboard today. I've been typing on it for some hours now and I must say that this keyboard is the BOMB! My fingers seem to glide across it while typing! The key caps are so smooth to the touch. I love that I can actually type faster without making as many typos as I would on a regular style keyboard. This keyboard is a game changer for anyone who needs to do heavy duty typing tasks. I must also add that it has the most addictive creamy clicking sound! And the RGB lights are really cool and fun to see. Another plus is the tri-mode connection feature. The USB receiver has a slot that stores it right on the keyboard itself.  I really am pleased with the more compact size of this full keyboard to save room on top of the desk. It's substantial in its weight, not flimsy at all! I realize that I should have been buying a mechanical keyboard years ago because the other popular keyboards are not better than this one. Take note that you can change the keycaps anytime you want to change the look and style of your keyboard. You can only do this with a mechanical keyboard. The keycaps are not expensive either as I have already done research here on Amazon. I plan to purchase a couple of keycap sets in the future. Overall, I highly recommend this particular keyboard from AULA, I believe the price point is good for the quality of the keyboard. I would only recommend that they include the keycap tongs and a few gaskets with this keyboard as other manufacturers do.
reviews.author: Jasmina2007

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.comment:
Bought this for my wife’s WFH setup. She fell in love with the Creamy Switch craze on TikTok and this was a reasonably priced keyboard that fit the bill. I found a cute sakura themed keycap set to replace these, but she said she’d have been happy with the blues and purples that came preinstalled.
It looks great, feels and sounds fantastic, and does everything you’d want from a keyboard. She loves the size, specifically that it includes the number pad. Not enough decent keyboards do these days. People want minimalism in everything, but the functionality of a dedicated number pad is hard to beat.
Connecting is super easy. We’re using the hardwired USB-C option, but I was able to use Bluetooth on my laptop at work while I was testing and installing the other keycaps prior to giving this as a birthday gift. She loves that it’s such a lightweight feel of typing, even noticeably so to someone without the heavy handed typing of myself, having grown up on IBM and Alps switches which allow for some decent banging.
I’m not a keyboard snob or really a deep enthusiast, but some of my friends and coworkers that care more than I do really loved it as well. It’s a crowd pleaser, and that wonderful little subdued THOK on each tap is soothing as foretold.
reviews.author: Jackson

reviews.title: Bought it for my husband and now it's mine
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1UUR-Mp7bL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51hHye2CCwL._SY256.jpg First I want to say that I initially bought this for my husband as he had bought a walmart clicky brand keyboard and was finally growing tired of the clicky sound lol. Well as the keyboard enthusiast I suggested this one as it was simple and a few of the review videos had sounded promising.
When it arrived the first thing I noticed was the heft, this was made with durable material and not light weight at all, which put some ease to my mind that it wasn't just made of cheap plastic. The size was just perfect, I couldn't be happier, and when I typed for the first time the creamy and thocky sound just itched the right place in my brain. I could not get enough of it.
I love that there are 3 types of way that you can connect, BT; Dongle or wired. I always prefer wired.
The keycaps are nice, although I prefer rounded keycaps to the sharp square ones, I did replace the factory keycaps and I just fell in love with this more. The switches sound nice and deep and honestly, this is almost perfect for me, I'll be playing around with this keyboard especially since it's hot swappable and I might try other switches.
For those just starting out with interest in the keyboard area, this is a great first start with a not too expensive price point! I did end up having to buy another keyboard for my husband since I stole this one, it was definitely worth it though! Can't wait to mod this one a little more!
